content: Yesus amni-hyalli edon rpesiay wiali E'a
La'pa nhor nioma Yesus Nalala'a la' Galilea. Yesus Nahmena Nla'a Yudea, yoma makla' Yahudi o'tani-matni la' hande e rna'ohma pa rwen E'a.
Mere la'pa nwakrian wia la' lera yamuki-yahepru la Yahudi lerlalawanni maka nhi'inde ha rariria hoiwiali,
noma Yesus amni-hyalli rakot la Yesus riwra: “Yesus ee! Yana Mdiella Galilea, Mai pia itla'awa Yudea, totpena riy harahu maklernohor rer O'a re ramkek memna O hihi'imu-yapyapmu mak kamehi-kayona.

Yoma hota riy mak kwahaka rimormiori ya'ulli-yawedni de hota edonna nade'a-namoin nana hihi'ini-yapyapni. Pede la'pa Muatu Mhi' nan hihi'a-yapyapi mak kamehi-kayona, de hota Mlia' totpa noheri woru-lyanti nayanni ramkek nana.”
Rakot emkade yoma la' amni-hyalli re, nek de edonna rpesiay E'a.
Pede Yesus Nakot la re: “Hyal miy re, edon nte' ma'ta lera-mela maka Uplerlawna Ntutga pa hota Alia'a. Mere la' pa miy die, mlia'a la lera-mela hya' to'a.
La' nohkeran di mniotni de hota edon rwayotil miy. Mere la' A' di de nohmarna mniotni nahmena-naprai A'u, yoma nhi'inde A'g e ukot nohor mamaini ira yatni-halli.
Mere la'pa miy die, de hota mlia' pa mior wut lia riy pa mihe'i-mihepru. Mere mai A' die, A'g edonna lia' ma'ta, yoma lera-mela maka Uplerlawna Ntutga mai A'u, edon nte' ma'ta.”
Lirni emkade la'a hyalli re, ne edonna Nwaran la Galilea.
Yesus Nwatutu-nwaye'a la' Yahudi lerlalawanni
Mere la'pa amni-hyalli re rla rler teman la muki-hepur de noma lera woru-wotelu rtaw doinia na'nama Yesus Nmeh'a Nla' he'i-hepru, mere riy id mana edonna nat niohora.
La'a muki-hepur de plahwani, de o'ta-mata Yahudi re rwahaka E' riwra: “Riy de etla hanmeni?”
Rirahu la mutlialawna re rapupu-raheria Yesus ha Nlolola. Dom de e riwra Hade samoga. Dom de riwra Hade yata, yoma Entota riy la klieratni.
Mere rwahaur de ramta'ata rwet la Yesus nanni totpena rira yana ratlin nana, yoma ramta'at rer lia Yahudi re o'tani-matni.
La'pa ertepartarlia yamuki-yahepru la'a lera wotellu-wogatni la'a lerlalawan de, dewade Yesus Nmai pia Nodi liarni la Uplerlawna roma kreini pa Nwatutu-nwaye'a.
Yahudi o'tani-matni re honona rwer rer wiawni, yoma rwaror de riy di, edon Nlernan ma'ta krei-iskola agama re wniatutnu-wniaye'eni, pede emkameni pa Natu Nwatutu-nwaye'a oleka pa emkade?
Noma Yesus Nakot la re Niwra: “Hya' mak Awuatutu-wuaye'a ri, de A wniatu'tu atia' hare, mere Mak khopn A die wniatutnu hade.
Riy mak kiwra klernohora Uplerlawna ralma-riorni, nanpena er mak kat niohora A wniatu'tu di nwatiawua Uplerlawna onde nwatiawu tio'a A ralma-rior wamueh'u.
Riy meni mak knairia wniatut wamueheni, de nwahaka e nan wamueheni. Mere riy meni mak kwahaka Uplerlawna mak khopna e'a, nan kalwiedni, de ha ndella ploloini-mneneheni. E' edon npudi-nakla rira.

Miy e mliernan oleka Uplerlawna deullu-tatarni maka Musa nala tiy miy toh?! Mere riy id tiy miy miana edonna mitlina-mitail plollol la' deulu-tatar de, yoma la'pa plol toto' pa mliernohora deulu-tatar de, de hya'a nrei pia miwra mpien A'u?”
Noma rirahu riwra: “Hegana-kawnu nhu'r ralm O' ee! He' ed mak kiwra kwen O'a?”
Noma Yesus Nakot la Niwra: “Eneknek to'ama Aghi' hihi'a-yapyapi mak kamehi-kayona id la' Sabat lerni de, de mimpier rer wapmi yoma A'g e kari la' ler de.

Mere hota miy mieh'a neka msiunat la'a Sabat lerni totpena yana mpiera-mdiaitia deulu-tatra sunat maka Musa nal tiy miy. Ne sunat de nek de Musa deullu-tatarni atia' walia hade, mere it upni-tgarni (Abraham, Isak, me Yakopa) deullu-tatarni.

La'pa miy mhiur niohor riy pa rsunat keke'enku'a la Sabat lerni totpena yana rpera-rdaitia Musa deullu-tatarni la'a sunat, nihya'pa miwenan mai A'u yoma Aghi' kalwieda riy mak kamehra de pa inonni tetema nkalwieda la'a Sabat lerni?!
Yana mniairia hya' maka mimkeka onde mitlin to'a pa mhiudi-mpiara A'u mere mhiudi-mpiar de mliola plollolli-mneneheni.”
Rira ratiana: Plola la Yesus de Ray Makamori-Kalewna maka Uplerlawna Nano'taru inhatta?
Dewade mak kden la Yerusalem dom de riwra: “Yanpa Hadi ed maka ha rahak pa riwra rwenna?

Tamkek la Naltier die Nto'pi-ngaur to'a maka Ha Nakotkota la'a mutlialawna ralamni, ne riy id mana edonna npolliohor nan lirni. Yanpa it o'tani-matni re rat niohora oleka la' hade de Ray Makamori-Kalewna inhatte?
Mere la'pa Ray Makamori-Kalewan de Nmai die hota riy id mana naplinga Ha Nwatiawu meni pa Nmai. Mere riy di genni-tienni de it tatga.”

Yesus Nwatuttut rier mia'ta la'a Uplerlawna roma kreini, dewade Nhaun pa Niwra: “Miy e mikota de miy miatga he' A'u me Awuatiawua la' hanmeni pa Amuai. Mere A'g edonna godia ralma-rior wamueh'u pa Amuai, mere Uplerlawna ed mak khopan pa Amuai, de E' ed mak ha rpesiaya. Mere miy die de edonna miatg Uplerlawna.
Mere A' die Agatga E'a, yoma Awuatiawu E'a, ne E nekpa ed mak khopna Amuai.”
Yesus Nakot emkade de riy rwaror pa riwra rtorna wa mere riy id mana edonna nte'la la E'a. Yoma edonna nte' ma'ta la lerni maka Uplerlawna Ntutga oleka wa.

Ne rirahu la'a nhiopnu-pniepan de na'nama rpesiay E'a pa riwra: “Plol toto'a pa Ray Makamori-Kalewna eda di. Yoma la'pa Ray die Nmai, de hota hihi'a-yapyapi mak kamehi-kayona maka Nhi' nan de edon nareh dioin maka riy di Nhi' nan oleka re!”
Rwahak talan pa rtorna Yesus
Riy Parisi re ratlin nana rirahu e rapupu-raheria lir emkari la'a Yesus, noma rla' pa rora imam Yahudi o'tani-matni re rpolga mak katiaka Uplerlawna roma kreini me rhopan pa rla' rtorna Yesus.
Noma Yesus Nakot la riy mutlialawna re Niwra: “Hota la' lera ho'ke'eni di nmeh'a to' pa Agora miy, nhor diewade A'uwali owa'an la' E' maka khopan pa muai.
Hota mimihak A'u mere miy die edonna mpiatroma A'u yoma hota ta'en niana mlia' nan gen miaka Adiella.”

Noma o'ta-mata Yahudi idma natian ida, riwra: “Hota riy di Niwra Nokur meni pede hota it edonna tlernana? Yanpa Niwra la' teman la riy Yahudi mak klaun la riy ornoha, totpena Nla Nwatutga riy Yahudi atia'a la' hande?
Hade Niwra hota itahaka E'a, mere hota it edonna twatrom nana me hota taken niana itla'a gen miaka Endella de! Lirni re nnia'eratni hya'a de?”
La' lerlalawna maka Yahudi rnairia gera rhoratreria tuini-wedni, de Yesus Niwra E' ed mak kala gera-lahu mormiori inhatta
Noma la'pa la'awa la' ler maka rwewiei-rnarnar memna, de lera hohoni la' lerlalawan de. Noma Yesus Ntutrieri na'nama Nhaunu pa Niwra: “Riy maka tiernu kerna de nmai pia totpena Agalla nemnu.

La'pa hameni ed maka kpesiay A'u, hota enlernana hya' maka kahniorat tar la Puka ralamni de niwra: “Hota nwatiawua riy de ihranu ralamni, de emeknekama ger ormata nwahi'da pa nwau liora mak kodia mormiori plalahwa pa nodi liarni.””

Yesus Nakot hade de Enakot nohora Uplerlawna Nhiwni mak hota riy maka kpesiay E'a rlernana. Yoma la lera re de Uplerlawna Nhiwni edonna Nerun ma'ta yoma Yesus edon Narian ma'ta la heyanna pa Nlernana ya'uli-yawedi.
Rirahu ratlina-ratailia Yesus lirni-tunnu pa doma riwra: “Matialo'onama Makwohorulu-ktatrulu maka Uplerlawna Nano'taru pa nmai e inhatti!”
Dom de riwra: “Ray Makamori-Kalewna maka Uplerlawna Nano'taru inhatti.” Mere dom de edon rpesiaya pa riwra: “Ray Makamori-Kalewan nek hadina ne nwatiawu Galilea liewnu?!
La'a Puka ralamni de niwra hota Ray Makamori-Kalewan de edon nwatiawua Galilea mere Daud duratni-waitni hade, pa hota Enwatiawua Betlehem pa nmai, yoma Daud nohoni-raini etla hande.”
La'awa hohoni dewade rirahu rawo'or nohora Yesus.
Dom de riwra rtorna, mere limni edonna rlok la inonni.
Yahudi o'tani-matni edonna rpesiaya

La' hohoni dewade mak katiaka Uplerlawna roma kreini, maka rhopan pa rla rtorna Yesus, rawal wia. Noma imam-imam re o'tani-matni ror riy Parisi re ratiana re riwra: “Nihya'pa miy edonna miodi Hade pa mmiai?”
Noma maka ha rhopna re rwalolla riwra: “Ami edonna matlin ma'ta riy raltier die emek E'a!”
Noma Parisi re rakot la: “Hoi! Yanpa Enwotar nan olek miy wiali pa miy miana mlier la klieratni?
Mimkek teka, la'a o'ta-mata mak kodi plolli la mai ita me riy Parisi re, e rpesiaya riy de?
Edonna toh?! Mere riy mutlialawna ri podaknu pa edonna rat niohora Musa deullu-tatarni. Ir rmeh'a neka er mak kpesiaya. Ne hota ir nekane rlernana Uplerlawna niukamnu!”
La'pa riy Parisi id mak kden la hande nwawa Nikodemus, maka kmai olek la Yesus la' ler dello! Noma nakot la Parisi re korni niwra:
“Ama-hyali miy re! La'a niukmu yala'ani plollolli de miala pa riy rwalol nohor pleini hihi'ini-yapyapni de nanpena mietlia niukamnu.”

Noma Parisi re rwohora-rtatra Nikodemus riwra: “Hoi! Yanpa riy podku-padku mak kwatiawua Galile' id o'a pa hota emekwali Yesus de. Hota mlia' pa mpuahaka la' Puka ralamni. Puka ralamni de edon riwra mak kden la Galilea hota rla'a makwohorulu-ktatrulu!”
[La'pa rwahaur pa nhorwua noma honona rla'awa romni.
